evidence.title: Repository R1 validation case family
evidence.supports: Internal structural conformity and descriptive applicability.
evidence.limitations: Shared research process, missing raw runs, missing exact prompts/models, non-recomputable historical percentages, no independent replication.

evidence.title: Propagation refinement ablation
evidence.supports: Suggestive separation of Origin Network as structure and Propagation as behavior.
evidence.limitations: Single case, shared evaluator, no raw outputs, no counterbalancing, ordinal author-assessed result.

evidence.title: CFCV comparator family
evidence.limitations: Comparator methods were narratively reconstructed, not independently executed under matched budgets.

evidence.title: Execution provenance gap
evidence.supports: No completed experiment preserves the raw execution bundle required to recompute historical performance claims.
evidence.limitations: Absence is based on discoverable repository artifacts as of the review dates.

evidence.title: Independent replication gap
evidence.supports: Independent-human reproducibility and controlled longitudinal performance remain untested.
evidence.limitations: Future completed studies can supersede this evidence state.

evidence.title: 2026-07-30 non-human experimental comparative analysis
evidence.supports: Current claim downgrades, alternative explanations, and the next controlled benchmark design.
evidence.limitations: This is a repository audit and synthesis, not new independent performance evidence.

evidence.title: External reproducibility terminology and transparency cross-check
evidence.supports: The need to define reproducibility/repeatability/replication operationally, state changed conditions, and preserve sufficient computational artifacts for recomputation.
evidence.limitations: These sources validate research-method terminology and transparency principles; they are not evidence that EDF itself performs well.

evidence.title: EX-EDF-001 structural-value benchmark preregistration
evidence.supports: A construct-aligned, frozen, fail-closed test now exists for HY-EDF-008 and can preserve future run provenance.
evidence.limitations: No analyzer run, evaluator score, or EDF performance result exists yet. This is procedural evidence only and must not be used to promote HY-EDF-008.
